jobs.title: Bus Data Coordinator
jobs.description:
Title: Bus Data Coordinator

Requisition ID: 12414

Work Type: Fixed Term Full Time

Fixed Term Period: 30/6/2027

Location: Melbourne - CBD

Date Posted: 4 Oct 2026

About Us

We create thriving places and connected communities. We plan, build and maintain Victoria’s transport, planning and land services. We are committed to a safe, inclusive and high-performing workplace.

We welcome applicants from diverse backgrounds and are committed to creating a safe, inclusive workplace where our people can thrive and do meaningful work.

About The Role

This is a Fixed Term Position until 30 June 2027

The role manages and maintains accurate spatial and timetable data representing Victoria’s public transport network. This includes bus stops, routes, paths of travel, geospatial information and timetables used by DTP, customers and the transport industry.

The role ensures data is accurate, consistent and fit for customer information across websites, journey planners, apps, signage and stop timetables. It also manages data imports and exports, anticipates network changes and ensures data requirements are met before changes take effect, working closely with DTP teams, transport operators and external agencies.

What
we’re
looking for
(Selection Criteria)

You’re Someone Who

Builds positive stakeholder and customer relationships, responding promptly to needs and delivering high-quality outcomes.
Communicates clearly and professionally, presenting information logically and adapting communication to the audience.
Works collaboratively and respectfully, using strong interpersonal skills and a constructive, diplomatic approach.
Thinks critically and solves problems, following established processes, identifying solutions and seeking guidance when required.
Adapts to changing priorities and works across teams, with a foundational understanding of geospatial data, mapping and spatial tools.

Click

here
to access the Position Description.

Qualifications And Experience

You’ll bring:

List Qualification in, Data Management and/or Spatial Sciences or GIS.
3+ years of professional experience
Experience and expertise in the use of GIS mapping products similar to or including ArcGIS.

Pre-employment checks and employment conditions

Relevant pre-employment screening and reference checks will be required.

Applicants must be an Australian Citizen, Permanent Resident or hold a valid work permit or visa necessary for the nature of the position.

Recipients of Victorian Public Service (VPS) voluntary departure packages should note that re-employment restrictions apply.

How To Apply

Click the ‘Apply’ button to be redirected to our recruitment platform, where you may need to create an account to submit your application.

Applications close at 11.59pm on Monday, 19 October 2026
.

Please include both your resume and a cover letter addressing how your experience addresses each of the key selection criteria for the role. All applications must be submitted via the online portal, we’re unable to accept email or manual submissions.

For further information about the role, please contact Carly Illingworth, Senior Bus Data Coordinator at Carly.illingworth@transport.vic.gov.au.

Redeployees

If you are a VPS redeployee, please state this in your cover letter and include your case manager’s contact details. This helps ensure your redeployment status is appropriately considered. For more information on redeployment, visit the Victorian Government policy.

Important Information

If you require any adjustments to fully participate in the recruitment process or need the advert or attachments in an accessible format (e.g., large print), please contact us. We're here to support you.

jobs.title: Conservation Officer
jobs.description:
At Bath & North East Somerset Council we have one overriding purpose to improve people’s lives.

About The Role

We have the following position available:

Fixed Term Contract - 2 years

Bath’s international significance is recognised through its dual World Heritage Site designation, extensive conservation area, and exceptional concentration of historic buildings. Beyond the City of Bath, the wider Bath and North East Somerset area contains a rich and diverse historic environment, including locally distinctive vernacular architecture, nationally important archaeology, and significant industrial and coalmining heritage.

Across The District There Are

over 6,000 listed buildings (approximately 3% Grade I, 10% Grade II* and 87% Grade II);
35 conservation areas;
16 registered historic parks and gardens and
a wide range of undesignated local heritage assets.

To help protect, manage, and enhance our exceptional historic environment, we are seeking experienced historic built environment professionals to join our specialist team on fixed-term contracts of up to two years.

This is an exciting opportunity to contribute to the conservation and sustainable management of a unique and valued heritage asset while working alongside a dedicated team of experts.

Please note:
these roles are offered on a career-graded basis. The grade appointed will reflect the successful candidate's qualifications, skills, knowledge, and experience.

Grade 7 Conservation Officer Level 1 (RP067)-£35,570 to £38,510 per annum
Grade 8 Conservation Officer Level 2 (RP068)-£39,481 to £42,123 per annum

The Team And Work You Will Do

You will work within a wellestablished, multidisciplinary team of conservation and other specialist colleagues. The team undertakes a wide and rewarding range of work, including:

managing, assessing, and recommending decisions on listed building consent and planning applications;
advising on development proposals affecting heritage assets;
guiding new development and capital projects with historic environment implications;
conservation area designation, review, and appraisal;
work on heritage at risk and
contributing to Local Plan policy development and site allocations.

There is also a particular opportunity to support Councilled projects, as the Council owns a substantial number of listed buildings across Bath and has responsibility for a wide range of functions within this uniquely sensitive historic environment.

About You

You will:

hold a degree in a relevant subject;
be a member of, or working towards membership of, the IHBC and ideally RTPI;
have a demonstrable track record in heritage conservation, the planning process, and achieving highquality outcomes;
possess a strong understanding of national and local historic environment policy and legislation and
have previous local government experience.

Why join us?

We are a positive, supportive, and collaborative team, committed to delivering excellent outcomes for both heritage and communities. You will have the opportunity to work in a worldclass historic environment, contribute to addressing major challenges such as climate change and retrofit in historic buildings, and help shape the future of one of the UK’s most significant places.

If you are forwardthinking, ambitious, and motivated to make a real difference, we would be delighted to hear from you.

We support flexible working with the opportunity to move between the award-winning, modern Civic Centre in Keynsham which will be your main office base, and other Council locations in Bath and Midsomer Norton as well as some homeworking.

Interviews and information

We aim to hold all interviews for this position face-to-face, as we believe this offers the best experience for candidate and panel members.

If you require further information or want an informal chat about the role, please contact Deputy Head of Planning, Paula Freeland or Principal Conservation Officer, Jayne Boldy by e-mail at ,

Interview date: TBC

Please no agencies.

Please note, BANES Council operates a policy of prior consideration for roles for any individual on the Council’s at-risk register (redeployee). This means should a redeployee express an interest in this role, providing they meet the essential criteria for the role they will be considered ahead of external applicants.

Please note that this advert may close earlier than the stated closing date due to high demand. We advise all interested candidates to apply as soon as possible.

About Bath And North East Somerset Council.

Working at Bath and North East Somerset provides an opportunity to contribute to your community and make a positive impact on the lives of residents. Our values shape how we work to deliver public services, and how we communicate with the residents we serve. We care about the best outcomes for local people, through our public services.

Why Bath and North East Somerset Council?

We offer a wide range of benefits, to ensure that you are paid fairly for your work, have the flexibility to enjoy a great work/life balance, and have the support you need. Go to

At Bath and North East Somerset Council we have one overriding purpose to improve peoples lives. Find out more about our values at

We aspire to have a diverse and inclusive workplace and strongly encourage suitably qualified applicants from a wide range of backgrounds to apply and join us. Find out more on our commitment to Equality, Diversity and Inclusion at

We are a Disability Confident Employer find out more at

The Council is committed to having a diverse and inclusive workforce. Applications for job-share, part-time and flexible working arrangements are welcomed and will be considered in line with business needs.

jobs.title: Junior Sales Trader - Environmental Commodities
jobs.description:
We are seeking highly ambitious commercial talent
to join our team in New York.

Are you driven, energetic and extremely outgoing, this is the role for you. We are considering candidates with a strong character, above average communication skills and an affinity for deal making, ready to launch their career into the renewable energy space.

Are you that natural born winner
ready for your next challenge?

About Us

OTC Flow is a leading environmental commodity trading company with offices in Amsterdam, Paris, and New York. We provide trading liquidity in every global environmental market.

Our mission is to provide our global partners with access to renewable energy markets and to assist them in achieving their sustainability goals in an informed and intelligent way. Our network of partners is ever-growing and includes major actors across the entire renewable energy value chain.

About the Role

In your role as a Sales Trader
, your main focus will be to build your own client portfolio by closing transactions within the renewable energy space. Taking initiative is highly valued at OTC Flow, where acting on own ideas for growth within your market segment will be incentivized.

OTC Flow acts as intermediary within over-the-counter markets
so you will actively engage in outreach and prospecting through cold calling and client meetings. Your success in this role will rely on your ability to connect with counterparties both verbally and in writing as all transactions are bespoke and tailor-made
.

We do not look for quantitative candidates, but instead for candidates with a financial background in combination with a very strong commercial drive.

OTC Flow will enable you to become successful in this field by providing close guidance by senior management and direct access to all internal resources from the start. We strongly believe in meritocratic values so your growth within the company can be steep since more opportunities will come to those showing commitment, high energy and results.

Main Responsibilities

Be responsible for achieving your own trading revenue ( PnL
);
Continuous sourcing and developing of quality leads;
Proactively build your client portfolio through direct prospecting via cold calling
and networking events, leveraging your exceptional communication skills;
Identify trade opportunities and support in executing them, from origination until closing
, with complete freedom to negotiate
on pricing and to dictate all deal terms;
Provide daily pricing and insights into your market, both internally as well as towards your counterparties, hereby establishing yourself as expert in your field;

About You

Bachelor's degree
or higher in Business, Economics, Finance, or a related field;
Very motivated
person, being proactive, resilient, and highly ambitious;
Exceptional communication skills
and able to quickly make interpersonal connections;
Strong drive to close deals and create impactful results for both yourself, your clients and OTC Flow;
Minimal 1 year experience
in B2B sales, brokerage, trading or similar client-facing roles;
Proven experience within renewable energy related markets is a must.

What We Offer

Hands-on, in-house training
on industry knowledge and sales practices, directly provided by senior management;
The opportunity to prove yourself quickly within a highly commercial setting, where a steep learning curve is guaranteed;
A young and ambitious team with a strong focus on meritocratic rewards;
Compensation is directly linked to your performance through a transparent commission structure
tied to sales results;
Comprehensive benefits
package, including health, dental, vision, and 401(k) options;
20 vacation days
per year.

Remuneration

Base salary plus an uncapped formula-based bonus structure linked to personal performance.
Base pay may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, level, and experience. It is only one aspect of the comprehensive and competitive compensation package offered to employees.

What's Next

If we have just described your profile, don't miss out on this opportunity.
The recruitment process:
Submit
your application with your CV;
Pre-screening call
with our talent acquisition team;
1 - 2 interviews
.

We believe in the strength of our diverse team and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can grow – together as a company, in teams, and as individuals. That's why we carefully consider all job applicants, fostering a culture that embraces everyone.

Please note that we are unable to provide visa sponsorship for this position. Candidates must be authorized to work in the USA without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future. Applications from candidates who require sponsorship will not be considered at this time.

Entry level

Employment type

Full-time

Industries

Environmental Services, Financial Services, and Services for Renewable Energy
